channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: British study ties nicotine pouches to quitting success for non-vapers as Ottawa holds firm
item.description: Nicotine pouches are increasingly being used as a smoking cessation aid in Great Britain, with their use among adults attempting to quit nearly tripling between 2021 and 2026. (Published on November 06, 2026bywesternstandard.news)

item.title: Istanbul Tobacco Control Conference Pushes War on Safer Nicotine Alternatives
item.description: The 11th European Conference on Tobacco Control, held in Istanbul from 4–6 November, has raised concerns over proposals to bring nicotine under international drug control frameworks. (Published on November 06, 2026byprohibitiondoesnotwork.com)
